aggregation_definition.row_job_identity: Matching immutable registered_pair_jobs_at_review entry in SHA-bound root review; state.json not read
aggregation_definition.update_samples: All update_end.seconds of the one complete own attempt; exact start/end cursor;500 updates per arm; no filtering
aggregation_definition.full_validation: All validation_end seconds/window_forwards SHA-matched to raw artifacts. Fresh0+500 each arm; resumed only new boundary
aggregation_definition.memory_peak: Maximum recorded peak_cuda_memory_allocated/reserved_bytes over all events in this arm attempt
aggregation_definition.cache: All own JSONL event counts/timings retained; publication/eviction bytes may count repeated logical keys
aggregation_definition.statistics: statistics.mean,statistics.median,sum,max over all finite nonnegative timings; all spikes retained
aggregation_definition.cost: Unique terminal Slurm one-L40 elapsed_seconds only; no phase/cache time added

limitations: 33829 GPU seconds covers only these eight allocations, not all formal training or all project cost.
Update includes provider fetch/generation and training. Validation/checkpoint work follows outside that update timer; feature generation nests inside cache publication and provider calls.

cache_hit.seconds includes stripe/SQLite wait, integrity checks, deserialization and recency transaction; it is not pure lock wait. cache_publish also includes generation/serialization/eviction, not pure I/O.
A precedes B using shared provider/cache; concurrent peers change hits/misses/contention. No causal A/B training speed or causal token-budget acceleration is identified.
Object is fresh0-to500 with two validations per arm; other jobs resume their next500 with one validation per arm. Totals are not matched identical protocols.
No linear72-arm extrapolation, remaining wall-clock estimate, final success/latency claim or live job/cost state is produced.
All original raw data and failures remain retained; this summary does not replace the unique Slurm cost ledger.
